title: JobReport
description: Top-level report emitted by every security-platform-toolchain tool at the end of a run.

job_id.description: Unique identifier for this pipeline run (e.g. Jenkins BUILD_ID, UUID).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced this report.

status.description: Overall outcome of the tool run.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp at which the report was emitted.

duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock duration of the tool run in seconds.

exit_code.description: Process exit code of the tool.

results.description: Inline tool results (optional; may be in a separate file instead).

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata (image version, git ref, etc.).
